column1: # VolumeLogToLinear golden: the Music/Sound slider's 64 steps over
# each step's value taken through gmenu_slider_get (Source/gmenu.cpp:381-386),
# remapped to millibels and raised as 10^(mb/VolumeScale)

# float32 rounding of powf is a documented approximation (no C++ offline
# soundsample probe exists to pin it).
